scope: Known-pose initialization from only the registered condition's native 256x256 source RGB8 and its source cameras. Pose and intrinsics stay fixed.

scene_scale.rule: Euclidean distance between s00 and s03 optical centres in the shared metric world; invalid/zero endpoints are a calibration failure.

pairs.enumeration: All unordered allowed source pairs in registered order, including M2 two-view tracks.
pairs.epipolar_error: Maximum of the two perpendicular distances in native pixels to lines from F=K_b^-T [t_ba]x R_ba K_a^-1; finite lines in both images required.

tracks.alias: In each source, merge keypoints at the same coordinates to 0.001 px, ignoring orientation/scale; use actual subpixel position of the stable representative.
tracks.rank: Edges sorted by worst directional ratio, maximum epipolar error, descriptor distance, then endpoint (view index, feature index). For aliases use strongest detector response and earliest feature index on ties.
tracks.merge: Greedy union only if components do not contain conflicting feature IDs from the same source. An already-joined compatible cycle adds no new observation. Each observation belongs to at most one track.
tracks.triangulation: Homogeneous DLT from all normalized image observations and world-to-camera [R|t], float64 SVD, no pose or lens fitting.
tracks.positive_depth: Every observation has near_m < camera-Z < far_m in the registered source calibration.
tracks.duplicate_rule: Greedy metric radius suppression in descending track length, ascending maximum reprojection error, then lexicographic observation IDs. Distinct retained points are never tiled to fill a target count.

qualify.decision_time: Before optimization from source statistics only. If every gate passes use all retained observed points. Otherwise use the single declared camera-random fallback and report each failed gate.

fallback.ray_coordinates: Sample one independent continuous x,y per 8x8 pixel-edge stratum, convert to integer-centre coordinates by subtracting 0.5; enumerate source then row then column. World positions are distinct random depth hypotheses, not triangulated surface measurements.
fallback.focus: Closest positive points on the two endpoint optical axes via least squares. Use each endpoint's own positive axial distance. If angle is below 1 degree or above 179 degrees, system is rank deficient, either solution is nonfinite/nonpositive or outside that source's near/far, use 3*scene_scale for both endpoints.
fallback.clip_interior: Work in the inset interval [near+1e-6*(far-near), far-1e-6*(far-near)], clamp the focus into this interval then intersect focus +/- 1.25*scene_scale. Reject invalid calibration or a nonpositive/empty interval. Draw uniformly in 1/Z on that positive interval. Backproject using the endpoint K and c2w.
fallback.color: Bilinear observed RGB from the endpoint that supplied this ray; no claim of correspondence.

parameters.geometry: means in canonical original metres; isotropic standard deviations, no scene rescaling.
parameters.color: Bilinearly sample each source display-RGB8 at its observation (clamp indices to the nearest border), IEC sRGB EOTF on each interpolation, take per-channel median of available linear RGB. Clip to [0.001,0.999], then logit.
parameters.physical_footprint: Per point median camera-Z/sqrt(fx*fy) over its registered observations; metres per pixel.
parameters.scale_proposal: Larger of 1.0 physical pixel and 0.5 times median Euclidean distance to the nearest three distinct initialization points.
parameters.scale_bounds: Lower=max(0.75 physical pixels,0.001*scene_scale); nominal upper=min(8 physical pixels,0.075*scene_scale). If the lower bound exceeds that upper bound, the upper is raised to the lower and the conflict is counted. Clip each proposal to this interval.

records: all source PNG and source camera SHA
per-pair KNN, bilateral ratios, reciprocal and epipolar passes
finite DLT, positive depth, parallax, reprojection and duplicate rejections
retained track length, residual, angle and metric extent/percentiles
actual initializer and failed eligibility gates
fallback focus, depth bounds, seed and draw rule if used
color range, scale ranges/clamp counts, opacity, common endpoint SHA and scene_scale_m
init.npz SHA and numeric parameter content SHA
